messages.body:
Hello,

Ronsay Power Station needs a diesel tanker on Saturday's 08:15. It is booked as TSF-2290 and was taken after the bookings list for the sailing was closed, so it is not on the bookings table and has no customer ticket. Tanker, 12.0 m long, 3.80 m high, 32,000 kg as booked, diesel UN1202 class 3; the shipper's declaration is in the scans folder and the weighbridge tally for it came in today. It is island fuel, so it is lifeline traffic; treat the time of this mail as the time of booking. Driver's mobile for the boarding text: +447700955290.

messages.body:
Hello,

Our usual round-up for the week.

Lashing gear: the two chains that failed inspection have gone back to the supplier and replacements are due on Thursday. Please keep using the spares in the lashing store until then.

Invoices: November's freight statements went out on Monday; Corrie Aquaculture and Strathy Quarry have both paid.

Saturday's 08:15: the Grazings Committee needs a second livestock lorry for the sheep coming back from the mainland wintering. It is booked as TSF-2291 and was taken after the bookings list for the sailing was closed, so it is not on the bookings table and has no customer ticket. Livestock lorry, 9.9 m long, 4.20 m high, 11,000 kg as booked. It is island livestock, so it is lifeline traffic; treat the time of this mail as the time of booking. Driver's mobile for the boarding text: +447700955291.

Rota: the freight desk is staffed until 20:00 on Friday and from 06:30 on Saturday.
